name: SDD Atomic Tasks Template (Framework-Agnostic RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE)
description: Framework-agnostic atomic task-based SDD with sequential tasks across four phases and mandatory verification. Each task requires proof of execution to prevent AI from gaming the system. CRITICAL: When tasks have multiple requirements (using 'AND', 'INCLUDE', 'ENSURE'), the AI MUST implement ALL requirements, not just the first one. Verify ALL acceptance criteria are met.

timeoutConfiguration.rationale: Prevent AI hanging on long-running tests and processes
timeoutConfiguration.implementation: Uses 'timeout' command with bash -c wrapper for better process control
timeoutConfiguration.fallback: If timeout fails, use 'npm test &' with 'sleep X && pkill -f npm' as backup
timeoutConfiguration.helperScript: timeout-helper.sh provides robust timeout with multiple fallback methods

metadata.description: Atomic 72-task structure with mandatory verification across four phases: Phase 1 (18 tasks), Phase 2 (18 tasks), Phase 3 (16 tasks), Phase 4 (18 tasks)

rules: Complete ALL tasks in the current phase without stopping
Never ask for permission to continue between tasks
Never pause to show progress or summarize mid-phase
Move automatically from task to task without interruption
Only stop when ALL tasks in the phase are complete and verified
Do not ask user to say 'proceed' or 'continue'
Execute tasks in continuous, uninterrupted session
continuousExecutionPolicy.violationConsequences: Task execution must restart from beginning of phase
antiEvasionRules: Never skip tasks due to complexity or difficulty
Never accept partial completion or 'good enough' solutions
Never skip tests because they are failing or problematic
Never work around issues - always fix them completely
Never provide summaries instead of actual implementation
Never treat status updates as task completion
Never implement only the first requirement when multiple are listed (AND, INCLUDE, ENSURE)
Never stop at structure/creation without implementing all requirements
Verify ALL acceptance criteria before marking task complete
